☕🌸 A lovely afternoon of tea, friendship, and connection!

Ladies from Peace Academy of West Texas enjoyed attending the First Lady Tea hosted by Hispanic Heritage of Odessa. It was a wonderful opportunity to meet new friends, share conversations, and invite them to our upcoming programs, including our Ladies Coffee Night.

Thank you to Hispanic Heritage of Odessa for your warm hospitality and this beautiful gathering. We look forward to growing these friendships and bringing our community closer together! 💐

#PeaceAcademyOfWestTexas #HispanicHeritageOfOdessa #FirstLadyTea #CommunityConnections #Friendship

🌿 Working together for a cleaner, more beautiful community!

On November 7, Peace Academy of West Texas volunteers, in partnership with Embrace Relief , took part in Basin Action Day, collecting litter and helping keep our shared spaces clean.

Thank you to our volunteers for giving their time and to basinbeautification for bringing our community together for this effort! 💚

Small actions make a difference when we work together.

#PeaceAcademyOfWestTexas #EmbraceRelief #BasinActionDay #CommunityService #PermianBasin

We’re happy to support Jesse Porras’s 13th Annual Community Thanksgiving Dinner!

🦃 Join us for the 13th Annual FREE Community Thanksgiving Dinner! Bring your family and friends for a time of gratitude, friendship, and community.

📅 Sunday, November 22 | 2:00 PM
📍 American Legion • 2701 East 8th Street, Odessa

🙌 We need 100 volunteers! We’re expecting a big crowd and need your help to make everyone feel welcome.

Ready to help? Fill out the short volunteer form using the link below or scan the QR code on the flyer:

https://pawtx.org/?volunteer=013ffde8-ea8c-4092-aa6b-c373b16918d2

❤️ Come share a meal—or lend a hand!

content:
A wonderful day of cooking, friendship, and celebration! 🥘💛

Today, Peace Academy of West Texas hosted a cooking class at the (@wtxfoodbank West Texas Food Bank. Together, we prepared delicious maklube and baklava, enjoyed lovely conversations, and shared the meal we made!

We also had the joy of celebrating the birthdays of Kelys H and Leslie Alvarez together. Happy birthday to both of you! Thank you for sharing your special day with us! 🎂🎉

A warm thank-you to our instructors, volunteers, and everyone who joined us, and to the West Texas Food Bank for welcoming us into their kitchen.

#PeaceAcademyOfWestTexas #WestTexasFoodBank #CookingClass #FoodAndFriendship
